title: Group wrap: add byte-exact external-oracle fixture for ECDH-ES+A128KW
description: Correctness review finding on worker6-9mkj.2. Shipped tests are contract-level only (uniqueness, algorithm string, round-trip); the key_pairwise_wrap vector is symbolic (pubkey_alice/unique_for_alice), so a derivation bug (wrong SuppPubInfo units, missing u32 length prefix, wrong AlgorithmID) would pass all tests while silently breaking cross-impl interop. Current code verified RFC-correct by independent hand-construction (SP 800-56A ConcatKDF + RFC 3394 AES-KW). Fix: add one byte-exact fixture from an external source (RFC 8037 A.4 ECDH-ES+A128KW example, or value computed offline with an independent JWE implementation) asserting the wrapped blob and 40-byte length for 32-byte secret / 24 for 16-byte. Also assert len(wrapped_key)==40 in round-trip tests.
